boundaries: Caller-declared ordinary single-reply execution; known stateful operations require sessions.
Lossless raw server error values; typed command facade/decoders are phase 05.
Retire on cancellation after possible write; no tombstones and no command replay.
Reconnect acquires future work only; old queued work fails definitely unsent.
Bounded push delivery is generation-tagged; full subscriptions are phase 09.
